caption: The drawing features a central human figure with a brownish-red hue, depicted from the torso up, with both arms bent at the elbows and hands pressed together in front of the chest in a gesture resembling prayer or contemplation. The figure is surrounded at the lower half and sides by a series of sharp, jagged, upright forms that resemble stylized, vertical rock formations or wooden shards, rendered in similar brown and reddish tones with subtle shading to suggest texture and depth. The composition is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or scenery. In the lower right corner, "ETHEL DOUGAN 1938" is written, indicating the artist and the year.
title: Carving "Soul in Purgatory"
